title: Dirac Wave Functions of Positive Energy with Arbitrarily Small Position Uncertainty
summary: We consider wave functions in the Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}=L^2(\mathbb{R}^3,\mathbb{C}^4)$ of a single Dirac particle, specifically from the positive-energy subspace $\mathcal{H}_+$ of the free Dirac Hamiltonian. Over the decades, various authors hypothesized that for wave functions from $\mathcal{H}_+$, there is a positive lower bound to the position uncertainty $σ_x$; in other words, that such states cannot be arbitrarily narrow in $x$.
